description: The plot illustrates average word repetition rates between generated training samples (K=32) across different relation categories, comparing three generation settings and their overall averages. The x-axis is labeled “Relation Category,” uses a linear scale, and spans integer categories from about 0 to about 65 with tick labels shown at regular intervals of 10 (0, 10, 20, 30, 40, 50, 60). The y-axis is labeled “Average Repetition Rate,” uses a linear scale, and ranges from 0.0 up to about 0.6 with evenly spaced tick marks of 0.1. Three solid line series with small point markers are shown: (1) a blue line labeled “w/o DPO obo,” which fluctuates across categories with notable spikes (e.g., near category 1 it rises to about 0.60, and near category 31 it peaks a little above 0.60), while many other points lie roughly between about 0.05 and 0.30; it starts near 0.25 at category 0 and ends near 0.05 at the final category. (2) an orange line labeled “w/o DPO obo & w/o div-hint,” which also varies across categories and includes higher excursions at several categories (e.g., near category 31 it reaches just under 0.60, and around the mid-to-late 40s it rises to roughly the mid-0.4s), with many values between about 0.10 and 0.35; it begins around 0.33 at category 0 and finishes around 0.16 at the end. (3) a green line labeled “DPO,” which stays lower overall and varies mostly between about 0.05 and 0.20, with an early higher point near category 1 around 0.30; it starts near 0.29 at category 0 and ends near 0.06. Three dotted horizontal reference lines indicate the mean of each setting: blue at 0.163 (“Average of w/o DPO obo”), orange at 0.227 (“Average of w/o DPO obo & w/o div-hint”), and green at 0.117 (“Average of DPO”), with these numeric values also annotated near the left side of the plot in their corresponding colors.
